items.markdown:
![Koh Phangan Full Moon Party Guide - OXA Koh Phangan](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07261854-1672-0139-0000-7154b8187d36:6)
The Thailand Full Moon Party is `a massive, world-famous monthly beach rave held on Haad Rin Beach on the island of Koh Phangan` . It features multiple music stages, neon body paint, and fire shows. Tickets cost ฿200 (cash at the gate).[](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/) [[1]](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Full_Moon_Party)

Upcoming 2026 Dates

- **31 July 2026** 
- **28 August 2026** 
- **26 September 2026** 
- **27 October 2026** 
- **24 November 2026** 
- **24 December 2026** 
- **31 December 2026** (New Year's Eve)[](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/) [[1]](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/dates)

Location and Travel

- **Where:** Haad Rin Nok Beach, Koh Phangan, Thailand.[](https://adventure360.com/guidebook/article/thailand-full-moon-party-dates-guide) [[1]](https://adventure360.com/guidebook/article/thailand-full-moon-party-dates-guide)
- **Getting There from Koh Samui:** Take a local ferry or a speed boat (30–40 minutes) directly to Haad Rin beach. Ferries run until evening, and return speedboats operate from 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM.[](https://adventure360.com/guidebook/article/thailand-full-moon-party-dates-guide) 
- **Where to Stay:** Book well in advance. You can stay directly on Koh Phangan (more expensive and books out fast during the party) or day-trip via speedboat/ferry from nearby Koh Samui.[](https://adventure360.com/guidebook/article/thailand-full-moon-party-dates-guide) [[1]](https://www.lensofjen.org/full-moon-party-dos-and-donts/)[[2]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attraction_Review-g293918-d4020022-Reviews-Full_Moon_Party-Ko_Samui_Surat_Thani_Province.html)

Essential Safety Tips

- **Footwear:** Always wear sturdy shoes or sneakers to protect your feet from broken glass on the sand.
- **Valuables:** Use a secure fanny pack or money belt for cash and your phone; leave expensive items and cameras at your hotel.
- **Fire Dangers:** Stay away from dangerous fire-jumping ropes and fire-limbo sticks.
- **Drinks:** Watch your drinks closely and stick to sealed bottles or standard beach bucket mixes bought safely.[](https://www.lensofjen.org/full-moon-party-dos-and-donts/) [[1]](https://melatiresort.com/thailand-full-moon-party/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vXhJz9kbG-A)
